elementor-column-gap-default"><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-408d502" data-id="408d502" data-element_type="column"><div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-22e1e46 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="22e1e46" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Kite Surfing</h1></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-5a300a1 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="5a300a1" data-element_type="section" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}"><div data-id="2ebce394" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><h6 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Harness the power of wind and waves</h6></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1480068f elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="1480068f" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Unlock Your Full Kitesurfing Potential</h2></div></div><section class="elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-8578cfc elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="8578cfc" data-element_type="section"><div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-no"><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-100 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-4657ee53" data-id="4657ee53" data-element_type="column"><div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5ff80b77 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5ff80b77" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><p><span style="font-size: 16px; font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit; color: #5b2a1f;">Looking for the best place to learn kitesurfing in Portugal? Welcome to </span><b style="font-size: 16px; font-style: inherit; color: #5b2a1f;" data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="72">CNC Kite&amp;Wing Center</b><span style="font-size: 16px; font-style: inherit; font-weight: inherit; color: #5b2a1f;">, located on the wild Alentejo in the Costa Vicentina Natural Park.</span></p><h3 data-path-to-node="6"><b data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="0">Why learn kite surfing in Portugal ?</b></h3><div><b data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="0"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Every afternoon, the famous Portuguese </span><i data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="39" style="font-weight: 400;">Nortada</i><span style="font-weight: 400;"> wind blows strong and consistent down the coast. Forget the struggle with heavy ocean waves, rough shore-break, and strong currents, we take you straight to our </span><span data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="217">flat-water lake training spot near Porto Covo</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">. Here, you get the powerful ocean wind on a smooth surface, making it the fastest and safest place to learn kitesurfing or wingfoiling.</span></b></div><p data-path-to-node="7">Our teaching system is optimized to maximize your water time and fast-track your progression:</p><ul data-path-to-node="8"><li><p data-path-to-node="0,0,0"><b data-path-to-node="0,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Flat-Water Advantage:</b> No waves means a stable, smooth board. You can focus all your energy on kite control and nailing your water starts!</p></li><li><p data-path-to-node="0,1,0"><b data-path-to-node="0,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Dedicated Boat Support:</b> Our school boat cruises right alongside you down the lake, keeping you in the best wind zones and watching over your safety.</p></li><li><p data-path-to-node="0,2,0"><b data-path-to-node="0,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Two-Way Radio Helmets:</b> Head coach Richard speaks directly into your Bluetooth helmet while you ride, giving you instant tips and encouragement right when you need it.</p></li></ul></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-3d276a1 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="3d276a1" data-element_type="section"><div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-no"><div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-3f4f17c" data-id="3f4f17c" data-element_type="column"><div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated"><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e56bb5c elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="e56bb5c" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Sand -
